items.text: Geamwaal gichea eenuusta Yesu
Hean abeeda ea nineekiit ghweelmeeda mukaatajeega miyeayiin hamiira siguura Basaaka.
Nea ashoohoodiga hees ea ng'oorshoodiga abeeda gwanda jeeda gasooda gichea ghoang'waayda ak gwanuus; ak iidu ghoawal buuneeda.
Yuda ghwamwas ghwalabwadaw Yesu
Hean ghoabita Shataani jeeda Yudayda siguura Iskariyote, nea gaba jeedeaba fugiga atamaniyeenyean;
Ng'ata gawa goobalool ashoohoodiga hees ea shirikareeda hees gida jea ghwalaapta bwadaw niny aba saawa.
Gahoosan saawa muuchi ak gwaheeleesa gideaba gajeataw lapiya.
Hean ghamwas ak gagasa gheata jea ghoalaapta bwadaw nea manda hiji eemeeda.
Yesu ghang'aap agita hamita Basaaka
Ghwahidu eaweeda ghweelmeeda mukaatajeega meayiina hamiira, nea eaweeda sinuusa dayeenda gisilleanda ghweelmeeda Basaaka gil.
Iidu goojeakta Yesu Betaro ea Yohana nea gwayeesha, “Aweayeena asisina heechea eeyeaksiina Basaaka.”
Ak geeyeesha, “Gigasayi eang'aabwa aba yeenu?”
Gwayeesha saawa, “Ang'ula, iyoahiti mujiini gajaroonyeewana ng'eedeeda sar sirbiida beega; ghoayaachi geeshtaanyi ea ahita gheeda jea gawa jeeda,
gooyeeshi siida bea gheeda, ‘Gwayi Giinealshoocheanda, abwaara ghooriini siyeaksi Basaaka aniini ea giinealangeasu?’
Ak gayghoahiimneegwa ghooriini haw sideeksa uhuumba nuut, ak ea siitaamdaam; ak goosisi jeeni.”
Hean gaweay ea mwahita ghwadaakta ng'asheega sean gidagwachi rukuteayda; hean gwasisin Basaaka.
Hamita Ng'utamiida
Hita damanda agiischooda goopteada niny ea giijasoodigaaschi gweagiischi.
Ak gwayeesha, “Neagasayi muuchi daak Basaakeeni aniini ea agooga heeda miidanyasa hang'weanidooda;
aba gideaba geayeeshiineegwa, maygutaak ea eahiit aba jeeda sugoocheanduumeeda ASEETA.”
Hean gageanu gikoombe, ak gabadiischeesa ak gwayeesha, “Oang'waanya gili, ak goolakiisiina geat;
aba gideaba geayeeshiineegwa, maygutali mideega haghweega sabiibu, ea ghwahidu sugoocheanduumeeda ASEETA.”
Ak gageanu mukaate, ak gabadiischeesa ak ghabwanach ak ghoadawaada saawa nea gwayeesha, “Nih saseedeanyu gil siitayda aba badahuukeagwa. Ahindunu aba giipkeateanyu.”
Ak gwahindunu eara gikoombe iing'ata agiischooda gwayi, “Bayoogi geahiida aba badahuukeagwa neajeeda eesh aba foojeandeanyu.
Ak goong'ulayi geatinda siichea ghwalaabwan bwadaw geambuucheewi aba hiji.
Asi Orjeeda Siida gayghabeada gidaghayi sibean eerarsiinda ak ea dashageada siidida jea ghwalaabwan bwadaw!”
Gabiisa goonyeari geat saawa, nea gwayi, Ng'eaha nih aba jeedeanya jea gwasin ng'asheanjiin.
Sheang'nyeeda hawunda
Iidu gwardu sheang'nyeeda aba jeenyaawa gideaba aahaw ng'eaha aba jeedeanya.
Gwayeesha saawa, “Sugoodiga eemoojiga inyeesa goombaliischi aba heanyaawa; giika mideawa gheambalmeedean aba heanyaawa geeguura fuga weeda buuneeda.
Agooga ea mii gichea awuurjeewana; aba agooga siida gasa hawunda dawuurjeewana siida mwanang'eawa sean, nea siida gasa ghang'ata mwadi dawuurjeewana siida gadiyeeda.
Aba gideaba aahaw ng'eaha, siida apteada ak gweagiischi, ghana siidida gadiyeesa buuneedean? Ak ghaaghanyi gajea siiteani agiischiini. Ak aniini aba jeedeang'wa geawuurjeewi siida gadiyeeda.
“Agooga goowooschi fuga ghayi milikiida galeagasean sea aniini aba jeeda simsindeanyu;
gawuurji gidaghayi goondaneani Bwaabwa sugoocheanduumeeda, eara aniini gaydagooneegwa,
Ak gajayeagiischeena nea gooleeshi aba jeeda sugoocheanduumeedeanyu, nea goopiitpiidi hoorgajeega sugoodiga ak goorgweaksi dooshin damaniyeenya bea Israeli.
Yesu ghwaramoar gideaba Betaro gayghwashaang'an
“Simon, Simon, ng'ula, Shataani gagaseegwa ghoalealdaneegwa ngaano,
ak aniini ea naamwaashchi ASEETA ea mwasuunya masaweagaagu, ama iibiiksean giimajeegi orjooga geamadu.”
Hean gwayeesha niny, “Ng'utamiida, geawooschi hidaat eara eeteayeena ghealooniga ghana dami.”
Gwayeesha, “Geayeeshiineey, Betaro, eanean maygooguul nghaghooda eaweani nea mii shaang'aan niba samwagu gideaba ginalaan.”
Shageeda ea sandakwajeanda ea ng'uta
Gwayeesha saawa, “Damanda eajeakteawaneegwa, nea moondeawani shageeda ghana sandakwajeanda ghana geeka, abeeda gwanda gida niishoadeeweegwa?” Geeyeesha, “Mandana.”
Gwayeesha saawa, “Ghamneawa siida mideawa shageeda daada, ak gwasunu eara dea mideawa sandakwajeanda. Nea siida mandeawana ng'uta ea dashaayda hang'daanyi ak ghwasha.
Aba gideaba geayeeshiineegwa ng'ooruutsu majaghanyi ea meahiida aba badaydeanyu, ‘Aba gideaba geegalageat sea fuga munyas’; aba gideaba gising'waar aba badaydeanyu gwanda mudeanoadaanyi.”
Hean gwayeesha, “Ng'utamiida, ang'wearda, hiji gwanda ng'utkeak iyeenya.” Gwayeesha saawa, “Gwadeay”.
Yesu ghamwaash ASEETA aba Giijeeda Saytuunajeega
Iidu gwarita ak gawa gawuurji gideaba eawoojisu, ea ghwahita Giijeeda Saytuunajeega, nea ghwaat geeshta giinealanga.
Hita hooweani gwayeesha saawa, “Amwaasha ASEETA adiidu geesimeegwa ak ghoapiti jeeda simsimda.”
Ghwanung'wa saawa heeda, ak ghwaloat geash gili ayang'da jakteayda lagheaneeda, ak ghang'uda gutung'weakaaschi ng'eanyi ak ghamwaash ASEETA, ak gwayi,
“Bwaabwa, iigidibwariiydi gil giischoarjaan bayoogi; nea adaghoah gida eagasiidi, nung' ghoah daang'u.” [
Hean ghwahidu malaykajeanda leabu humng'eeda ak ghoadaw uurda.
Iidu nea gwanda jeeda sawanadeeda, hean ghamwaash ASEETA muuchi; ak gawuurji gheawoocheandaanyi foojeanda nea goobitpisa ng'eanyi.]
Ng'eada mooshta ASEETA, nea gabiikta heeda giinealanga, ghwahita nea nilil aba gideaba ning'ut giiseaneega,
ak gwayeesha, “Ghwasaan anda goolili? Ang'eatng'eada amwaasha ASEETA adiidu ghoapiti jeeda simsimda.”
Ging'ooyda Yesu
Miighoabit ghuuta aba baloolda ghwahidu eemeeda nea goodeana siisi siguura Yuda, bea jeeda giinealanga atamaniyeenya, nea gooshooyna saawa. Gwaneekiisa Yesu ak ghwasam gheata;
gwayeesha Yesu, “Yuda ghamneawa gilaabi bwadaw Orjeeda siida aba samita gheata?”
Deagu fugiga mideawean gwayeesha, “Ng'utamiida gajeabwarana ng'utkeaka?”
Gafagu siyagi ng'utaanyi ak ghwalas soomjeanda ashoohoocheanda haw ak gwalaksa ng'eanyi iita geatinda dugwa.
Gwayeesha Yesu, “Anung'waada nideay!” Ghoang'waay iita ak ghoahaap.

Ng'ata gwayeesha Yesu ashoohoodiga hees, ea shirikareeda gheeda sibata ASEETA ea gweargwa, buwa ghoang'waay niny, “Ghoapkaandi gili oapkaanji oang'oanya mareanghweanda, nea gooyeadu ng'utkeaka ea gulupkeaka?
Eawoojisu nea geendeaydooschi galeagasean aba jeeda gheeda sibata ASEETA, ghanea miyoang'wanyaan ak ghamneawa nih ea damandeang'wa gil ea uurda misaneeda.”
Betaro ghwashaang' Yesu
Hean geang'waay ak geayaat ea eayaat gheeda Ashoohoocheanda haw. Gamaseaw Betaro nea sheagi;
iidu geayeat beasta aba bugharjeanda daghata gheeda nea geendeayi sean, ak eara Betaro gwanda hiji.
Ng'ata ghwadaah hutpa gadiyeeda nea gwanda heedeesh ak goohang'ooysa ghaang' ak gwayeesha, “Eara siisi gwandeaydooschi sea niny.”
Ghwashaang' nea gwayeesha, “Gatmooda, siisi aniini mwaanali.”
Miigageawiit ghwadaah siinuut ak gwayeesha, “Eara ang'iing'i gibeahi jeedeaba fugiga.” Gwayeesha Betaro, “Siida meabeahi.”
Iidu nea ning'ata aseedeanagi gwayeesha siinuut, “Aba huumwa siisi earada goodeaydooschi niny; aba gideaba niny siida Galilaya.”
Gwayeesha Betaro, “Siida, mwaanali eara gida inyaashi.” Deagheata damani duu gabaloolean, googuul nghaghooda.
Ghwayam geaw Ng'utamiida ak gang'ula Betaro. Ghoapkaat Betaro ng'asheanda Ng'utamiida, gidaghayi rukusiinda gideaba, “Eanean heeda miigooguula nghaghooda gajea niheawanaan niba samwagu.”
Hean gwarita jarooda ak gooyeawda muuchi.
Yesu geeshka nea geabwar
Ghwahita fugiga gwachi ang'waay Yesuun ak gwashika nea ghabwar;
Geegeanu ak geedukuta gheanyanga ak geepearsa nea geeyeesha, “Heapi rukuneasa siida lasnyi?”
Ak geerukusa ng'asheega saang'a bea giing'weaka.
Yesu geayaat madeeda girgweageeda
Sakteayda nea goorearu aseeta, gabadageat gweargwa sea ashoohoodiga hees, ea ng'oorshoodiga, ak geeyeadu madeeda girgweageeda, ak geeyeesha,
“Iiwoosi Gristo, girukuneasa.” Gwayeesha saawa, “Eara darukuneegwa, majaghanyi amwasa;
ak eara daanyaashcheegwa ng'asheanda ea mwajashaaha.
Nea gidang'eada ghamneawa Orjeeda Siida gaygoopteada aba meatkweeda geatinda dugwa bea ASEETA hoauur.”
Gwayeesha sean, “Aba seareani guwoosi Orjeeda ASEETA?” Gwayeesha saawa, “Goorugu agooga gideaba geawooschi.”
Hean geeyi, “Asi gudeegassa mushooduspwa naaha? Aba gideaba siyiing'si geat ng'asheega ghuutaanyi.”
